# Vishnu Sai Jaswanth

Senior Backend & Applied AI Engineer (4+ years) based in Bengaluru, India. Founding-team engineer at 10x Productivity, building AI / creative-intelligence platforms end-to-end — multi-source data ingestion, multi-model LLM orchestration (Claude / Gemini / OpenAI), multimodal pipelines, a versioned knowledge platform, agent workflows, and Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure, serving 10+ enterprise pilots.

## Core stack

NestJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, BullMQ, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, Qdrant, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, structured outputs, RAG / embeddings, multimodal pipelines, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AWS, ECS / Fargate, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, GCP, Auth0, Puppeteer, Handlebars, Nx Monorepo, OpenAPI / Swagger.

## Currently shipping at 10x Productivity

- Owns the backend and applied-AI platform end-to-end — advertiser and competitor ingestion through multimodal analysis, creative strategy, asset generation, and client reporting for 10+ enterprise pilots
- Multimodal analysis system (Gemini / Claude / OpenAI, structured outputs) across 60+ production LLM call sites — extracts scene-level video structure and scores creatives across 5 strategic dimensions and 100+ configurable signals
- Two-layer knowledge platform combining deterministic SQL metrics with cached LLM-generated strategy (versioned JSONB) — powering 5+ LangGraph workflows and an OAuth-enabled MCP server
- Storyboard + creative production pipeline (Imagen reference grids, Fal AI / Veo 3.1, OpenAI, Bria) with tenant- and feature-level LLM cost attribution
- 13+ client-facing PDF report types via Handlebars templates and Puppeteer two-pass rendering
- Async onboarding + continuous sync (Meta Marketing API, Meta Ad Library, AppMagic) on BullMQ with Redis leader election — 10+ advertisers, 100+ competitor brands, no client-specific pipelines
- Terraform-managed AWS platform — 7 ECS Fargate services across isolated environments (RDS, ElastiCache, ALB, ECR, centralized logging, OIDC-based CI/CD)
- Authored the backend coding standards, testing rulebook, and shared test infrastructure used across the backend libraries in the monorepo
